Maya Tran: Quick heads-up — CloudWave reached out. They want a joint customer benchmark + a 45-min demo + blog post the week after the webinar. They also want us in their marketplace listing. Can we map owners and a routing plan for inbound leads? :wave:
Lucas Patel: Nice. Who’s the target buyer? dev platform or infra?
Sophia Reed: For the benchmark + webinar we should target developer-platform + platform eng. Benchmarks to show latency/cost delta vs managed endpoints.
Anika Gomez: I can own the webinar content and run the demo. Need a co-host from CloudWave — asked them to nominate someone.
dev-rel-bot: New calendar event draft: "CloudWave x Redwood — Benchmark & Demo" 2025-07-15 10:00 PT. Link: https://cal.example.com/event/abc123
Lucas Patel: Timeline check: webinar 7/15, blog publish 7/22, marketplace listing staged 7/24? That gives one week post-webinar for asset polish.
Maya Tran: That timeline works. Owners: Webinar/host: Anika, Benchmarks/data: Sophia, Blog + PR: Lucas, Marketplace listing copy: Maya (with CloudWave SME).
Sophia Reed: For the benchmark corpus I’ll run 3 workload slices: short-chat (<=128 tokens), assistant-style (256–1024), and long context (1k+). Will capture p50/p95 latency and per-token cost delta. Plan to push results by 7/10 so copy can bake.
Lucas Patel: Need measurable CTAs for inbound leads. Proposed routing: registrants -> demo requests -> SDRs; marketplace leads -> account handoff to Partnership AE. We should map by URL params.
Maya Tran: Can we use a single routing matrix? Something like:
```
source, utm_campaign, initial_owner, followup_queue
webinar, cloudwave-web-0725, SDR-webinar, SDR-inbound
blog, cloudwave-blog-0722, Content-SDR, SDR-inbound
marketplace, cloudwave-listing-0724, AE-partner, AE-triage
```
Anika Gomez: That CSV looks good. I’ll add the tracking params to the registration flow and CloudWave listings.
Lucas Patel: Messaging iteration — we should test two headline variants for the blog/webinar landing: "Cut inference cost by 3x for gen-AI workloads" vs "Scale LLM inference with predictable latency and lower cost". A/B headline will tell us which resonates more for dev platform folks.
Sophia Reed: Agree. For the benchmark narrative, avoid absolute claims without context. Use concrete test bed: model size, sequence lengths, batch sizes, quantization mode. Example blurb: "On a 1B-3B family model, Redwood runtime reduced p95 latency by 28% and cut per-token cost by 38% under bursty traffic patterns."
Maya Tran: Risk check: CloudWave needs logo + legal approvals for co-branded copy. Lucas, can you coordinate legal sign-off by 7/8?
Lucas Patel: On it. Will loop in legal and send a one-pager.
dev-rel-bot: Reminder scheduled: checklist review 2025-07-09 09:00 PT. Channel: #marketing (automated).
Anika Gomez: One more ask — live demo runbook. I’ll publish a short runbook (retries, fallbacks to recorded clip) by 7/11 and a slide deck by 7/12.
Maya Tran: Perfect. Action items summary:
- Anika: Host + demo runbook (due 7/11) and slides (7/12)
- Sophia: Benchmarks & dataset (publish results 7/10)
- Lucas: Blog + PR drafts + legal (draft by 7/9)
- Maya: Marketplace copy + partner coordination (7/13)
- dev-rel-bot: Schedule reminders (automated)

Maya Tran: If no objections I’ll spin up a shared Notion and add these owners + deadlines. :thumbsup:
Lucas Patel: +1
Sophia Reed: +1
Anika Gomez: +1
Maya Tran: Great — will post the Notion link once created and ping CloudWave for a co-host name. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
